title: Jiye Sada Hussain
body:
Karo dua jiye sada Hussain
Museebaton mein hai ghira Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Nabi ki aal par ajeeb waqt aaj aa pada
Hussain chhod kar Madina ja rahe hain Karbala
Lahad se aayi ek shikasta pehlu Bibi ki sada
Ghareeb ho rahi hoon aaj main
Tere hawale ae Khuda Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Badi museebaton se paala hai gule jamal ko
Chalai chakkiyan to god mein sula ke laal ko
Kiya hai faqon mein bhi poora uske har sawaal ko
Zamana dushmani pe hai tula
Mere Khuda hai bekhata Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Alam-e-Jari ke haath mein, amariyon mein bibiyan
Sawariyon ke gird hain abhi to Hashmi jawan
Ujad na jaaye Karbala mein ja ke haq ka karwan
Yeh gulistan rahe sada bahar
ho Tujh pe dukhiya maan fida Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Safar su'ubaton ka hai, bala ka saamna bhi hai
Hai tez dhoop ki tapish to garmiye hawa bhi hai
Hai saath Akbar-e-Haseen, Hasan ka mah-laqa bhi hai
Rabab ki hai god mein Sagheer
jo Ghutnon na chal saka Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Chiragh kaun ab mere mazar par jalayega
Mujhe qarar kis tarah tere baghair aayega
Tera firaq qabr mein sada mujhe rulayega
Na betiyan hon be-rida meri
Na be-kafan rahe mera Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Zamana kamsini mein dekhe to shuoor-e-mehjabi
Behan ki god chhodta nahin tha Asghar-e-Hazeen
Hussain bole muntazir hai Karbala ki sarzameen
Yeh keh ke god mein woh aa gaya
Hussain Hussain, Labbaik Ya Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Main sun chuki hoon Baba se ke tujh ko maara jayega
Atash mein teen din ke tere sar ko kaata jayega
Teri yateem bachi par taras na koi khayega
Katega meri god mein gala
Seena pe hoga sar tera Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Ba-chashm-e-tarya log kehte apne apne ghar gaye
Madine walon ke liye Hussain aaj mar gaye
Yateem apni Sughra ko hayat hi mein kar gaye
Bata raha hai shor-o-sheen
Yeh palat ke ab na aayega Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Juz uske kaun doosra nawasa-e-Rasool hai
Dil-e-Batool qabr mein yeh soch kar malool hai
Hazaron kaante aur akela Fatima ka phool hai
Likha jo nauha Shamshad ne
Faqat yeh hai teri ata Hussain
author: Maulana Syed Shamshad Ahmed
